description: QPU contention: light case-C traffic and a burst of 130 chemistry/variational jobs inside 10 minutes with 75-minute SLOs and mixed priorities. Classical fallback for chemistry (768 module-hours) cannot meet the SLO, so QPU slots are the scarce resource.
